![Lab Diamond Buying Guide - Learn How to Get the Best Deal](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-e8e53ac3c335:4)
Lab-grown diamonds are `100% real diamonds created in a laboratory that share the exact same chemical, physical, and optical properties as mined diamonds`.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/lab-grown-diamonds/)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)

### How They Are Made

- **HPHT (High Pressure, High Temperature):** Recreates the extreme heat and pressure found deep within the earth using a carbon source and a diamond seed.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)
- **CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition):** Uses a carbon-rich gas inside a vacuum chamber where carbon atoms settle layer by layer onto a diamond seed to grow the crystal.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)

### Key Benefits

- **Identical Quality:** They feature the same brilliance, hardness (10 on the Mohs scale), and are graded using the same 4Cs (cut, color, clarity, and carat weight).[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2607859594539411985,catalogid:6135250472292833834,gpcid:3846958281591845207,mid:576462870737455287&ibp=oshop)
- **Lower Cost:** Lab-grown diamonds typically cost significantly less—often less than a third of the price of a natural diamond—allowing for a larger or higher-quality stone within the same budget. You can compare options and customize pieces through retailers like [With Clarity](https://www.withclarity.com/collections/lab-diamonds).[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bENR6W_c0JU)[[3]](https://www.withclarity.com/collections/lab-diamonds)[[4]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/best-lab-grown-diamonds/)
- **Transparency:** They offer a clear supply chain and avoid the environmental disruption of traditional mining.[[1]](https://www.cleanorigin.com/diamonds/)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/lab-grown-diamonds/)

### Downsides and Considerations

- **Resale Value:** Lab-grown diamonds generally do not retain resale value the way natural mined stones do.
- **Market Trends:** Because they can be continuously produced, their market price continues to drop compared to finite natural stones.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bENR6W_c0JU)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/lab-diamonds/)

### What to Look For When Buying

- **Certification:** Purchase stones certified by reputable gemological laboratories like the IGI or GIA.
- **Laser Inscription:** Ensure the diamond has a micro-inscription on its girdle matching the serial number on its certificate.
- **Fine Jewelry:** You can explore ready-made designs or loose stones from specialized collections such as [Brilliant Earth](https://www.brilliantearth.com/lab-grown-diamonds/).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5HtQJRB4yoU&t=277)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/lab-grown-diamonds/)
